resources.string: Scripts and macros
Gestures and touch
Navigation and reading
Typing, keyboards and braille
Speech, announcements and volume keys
Script agent (SandFly Pro)

SandFly Pro writes a script from a description of what it should do, and tests it on the phone. Open the app the script is for, and use the Build a script with SandFly Pro command, or choose it in Settings, Scripts. The script opens in the script builder for you to accept, change or discard. Building a script uses much more of the monthly usage limit than an agent task.
Script builder

Make a script without code: rules that relabel, hide or silence items, change what SandFly says for them, read them as one item or add actions, and new reading controls, commands and triggers. Go to Settings, Scripts, New script. Record an action records a rule action as you do it in the app.
Macro recorder

The Record a macro command records the steps of a new macro as you do them: presses, scrolls, typed text, opened apps and commands. To stop, use Record a macro again. To record steps into an existing macro, choose Record steps on its screen.
Macros in apps and in Actions

A macro can run only in one app. With Show in Actions on, the macro is in the Actions menu of each item in its app. To run a macro from the home screen, choose Add to home screen on the screen of the macro. Macros have new steps, such as Tap at position, Touch and hold item, Set volume, Set timer, Call and Send message.
Tap, then swipe gestures
One to three taps with 2, 3 or 4 fingers, then a swipe, such as Double-tap, then swipe up with 2 fingers. Go to Settings, Gestures, Tap, then swipe. They have no command by default.
Two-finger angle gestures
Angle gestures with 2 fingers, such as Swipe up then right with 2 fingers. Go to Settings, Gestures, 2 finger angle. They need Handle two-finger swipes in SandFly.
Three-part swipes
One-finger swipes in three directions in one stroke, such as Swipe right, up, then right. Go to Settings, Gestures, Three-part swipes.
Two-stroke swipes
Two one-finger swipes with the finger lifted between them, such as Swipe right, lift, then swipe up. To turn them on, go to Settings, Gestures, Time between two-stroke swipes.
Shake and Quadruple tap on back
Shake the phone, or tap the back of the phone four times, to run a command. Go to Settings, Gestures, Shake, or Settings, Gestures, Back tap.
Touch lock

While touch is locked, touches on the screen do nothing. Use the Lock or unlock touch command, or press both volume keys to unlock. To lock touch automatically, go to Settings, Touch, Lock touch automatically.
Double tap taps the screen
In the apps you choose, activating an item taps it on the screen. Go to Settings, Touch, Double tap taps the screen.
Stop at the last item before wrapping

With Wrap around on, the first swipe past the last item stops there with the end sound, and the next swipe wraps. It is on by default, in Settings, Navigation. Wrap around in reading controls is on the same screen.
Focus text inside items separately
Each piece of text and each state inside an item gets its own focus. Go to Settings, Navigation, Focus text inside items separately.
Apps and keyboards with their own speech

With Speak only focus moved by the user, SandFly speaks only focus that you move, in all apps or in the apps you choose. Keyboards with their own speech turns off the speech of keys and typed text while a keyboard you choose is shown. Go to Settings, Verbosity.
Continuous copy
Collects the text of every item after the focused item without speech, scrolling on the way. At the end, check the texts to copy. The command is in Settings, Commands, Text editing.
Google Sheets
The table reading controls and commands move between the cells of the grid, and the actions of a cell include Edit cell and Insert formula.
New commands

Move to item on the left and Move to item on the right, Activate confirm button and Activate cancel button, Read from focused item by reading control, Repeat last spoken phrase slower, Read text field, Character count, Share image of focused item, Share screenshot, First reading control and Gestures for this app. Assign them in Settings, Gestures or Settings, Keyboard shortcuts.
SandFly keyboard

An input method for physical keyboards, with no keys on the screen. Held keys type the Alt character or the capital letter, keys pressed twice can type other characters, and Search emoji and Choose a symbol type emoji and symbols. To turn it on, go to Settings, Typing, Physical keyboard, SandFly keyboard.
Keymaps for keyboard phones

Keyboard phone keymap and Keyboard phone single-key keymap are for phones with a built-in keyboard, such as Unihertz Titan, BlackBerry KEY2 and Zinwa Q25. Go to Settings, Keyboard shortcuts, Choose a keymap.
Hold keys down after the touch and hold delay
At the end of the delay, SandFly presses the key down and passes the rest of the touch to the keyboard, such as for a Delete key that repeats. Go to Settings, Typing.
Braille commands
Type braille cells on the screen to run commands, search for an app, or find text on the screen. Use the Braille commands command. To change the cells, go to Settings, Braille, Braille commands.
Braille keyboard

Custom braille characters types characters or texts with braille cells that you choose. Update dot positions while typing moves the dots toward where your fingers land, and is on by default. Both are in Settings, Braille, Braille keyboard. Persian and Romanian braille tables are available.
Voice effects
The equalizer is now Settings, Speech, Voice effects, with Bass compression, Voice compression and Treble compression, and the Deep bass preset.
None in Speak punctuation and symbols

Leaves punctuation and symbols out of speech. To keep signs such as plus, minus and currency signs with numbers, turn on Say symbols that change meaning. Go to Settings, Verbosity, Speak punctuation and symbols.
Battery level

SandFly says the battery level every 5% or 10%, or every 15, 30 or 60 minutes. Go to Settings, Verbosity, Battery level. Announce call length and Include seconds in the time are also in Settings, Verbosity.
Notification list

List notifications newest first, without groups lists each notification as an item of its own. Leave media players out of the notification list leaves out media player notifications. Both are in Settings, Notifications.
Volume keys

SandFly handles every volume key press, Hide volume panel and Change speech volume silently while speaking are in Settings, Volume keys. With Shizuku, volume key shortcuts also work with the screen off.
User guide
The SandFly User Guide describes every feature. Go to Settings, Help & feedback, User guide.
